content:
sam_finance: Heads-up: Crestline Biosciences disputed INV-2026-910 for $26,400 citing unexpected spike in api calls. attached their usage logs and a short note.
miranda_billing: saw dispute. our usage shows a burst on 2026-04-02 at 03:00 UTC. not yet sure if it was legitimate. no card on file.
owen_support: customer opened a support ticket claim #12641: 'unintended load test by third-party vendor'. they attached a 3rd-party IP list and a screenshot of spikes.
lia_sales: Crestline just renewed last quarter; they're strategic. they want to avoid being sent to collections while we investigate. requested payment hold + partial payment of $6,600 to keep account active.
ravi_prod: i pulled request traces: a high qps long-running job executed for ~2 hours. looks like repeated: model streaming with long context. can reproduce cost estimate ~24,000 tokens => matches invoice. potential mitigation: rate-limiting rule not applied due to missing header.
miranda_billing: options: 1) accept partial payment and hold collections while we investigate (requires legal approval), 2) require full payment and open dispute after, 3) set up payment plan conditional on finding. thoughts?
lena_legal: legal OK with temporary hold + partial payment of 25% if customer signs a "payment-hold-and-dispute" agreement that preserves our right to collect if dispute is denied. must include card tokenization for future charges. I'll provide template.
collections_bot: Action: invoice INV-2026-910 status set to "investigation_hold". Dunning paused until 2026-04-15.
lia_sales: I'll ask Crestline to pay 25% today via link and sign the agreement. told them we need signed PDF + card on file for remainder.
sam_finance: if they pay 6,600, create AR note and put rest on hold. also request engineering post-mortem and a short remediation plan from product.
ravi_prod: will run a forensic slice and share findings by 2026-04-06. preliminary fix: enforce rate-limit header validation and add alert on >1000 reqs/min per token bucket.
owen_support: sent payment link and agreement. customer replied: "we can do 25% today; we insist the disputed amount be verified before further charges." asked for timeline.
miranda_billing: set manual invoice action: record PARTIAL_PAYMENT 6600 received via hosted link at 2026-04-03T10:05Z (tokenized card added). ledger snapshot:
account,invoice,amt,status
Crestline Biosciences,INV-2026-910,26400,partial_paid_6600
sam_finance: logged manual action and created AR watch. set reminder 2026-04-16 to evaluate dispute outcome and resume dunning if unresolved.
lena_legal: uploaded agreement template link: https://docs.redwood.com/templates/payment_hold_dispute. agreement signed and uploaded by customer.
lia_sales: customer appreciated the temporary hold and signed agreement. they asked for a credit if the dispute is upheld. we'll evaluate after prod forensic.
collections_bot: Reminder set: check_INV-2026-910 on 2026-04-16.
sam_finance: closing provisional thread: leaving investigation open. will re-open after forensic report or if another payment fails. closing ts 1999992460"
